label: Sticker / Prop
description: The personality layer: a physical prop that sits ON other content. kind 'stamp' (rotated rubber-stamp slam, e.g. SAVE / SHIPPED), 'gesture' (a small instruction like 'Swipe up to save' -- pair with an arrow in the text), 'pill' (solid label chip, e.g. STONKS), 'ring' (a drawn circle highlighting a spot). Position and size it with the component's position box. Seasoning, never the subject: 1-3 per scene max.

text.label: The prop's text (not used for ring)

color.label: Prop color (defaults: stamp/gesture amber, pill primary, ring green)
